words.example: Catch you later after the round.
Talk soon, I have a visitor.
words.exampleZh: 稍后联系，我这边有访客。

words.example: Kind regards at the end of the email.
words.exampleZh: 邮件结尾写上此致敬礼。

words.example: Please advise how we should proceed.
words.exampleZh: 请指示我们接下来怎么做。

words.example: Drain node four before the patch so running pods move to the other workers.
words.exampleZh: 打补丁前先排空四号节点，让正在跑的容器组迁到其他工作节点。

words.example: Cordon the noisy worker so the scheduler stops placing new pods there.
words.exampleZh: 把那台异常的工作节点封锁掉，调度器就不会再往上放新容器组。

words.example: The results pod restarted twice, and the lab feed paused for a minute each time.
words.exampleZh: 结果容器组重启了两次，每次检验推送都会停大约一分钟。

words.example: Keep the lab tools in their own namespace so they cannot see production secrets.
words.exampleZh: 把检验工具放在自己的命名空间里，这样它们看不到生产密文。

words.example: The ingress for the patient portal routes /results to the new API pods.
words.exampleZh: 患者门户的入口路由把 /results 转到新的接口容器组。
